entries.what: Grace drives four minutes to Flats High, arriving at 7:20 to beat the Vinca drop-off line, and teaches periods 1, 2 and 3 in B12.
entries.outcome: Ordinary Monday; lunch in B12 with Dana during prep.

entries.what: After school she checks the fridge calendar for Ramón's next dispatch shift and cooks dinner with Lola Cora's meals in mind.
entries.outcome: Dinner done; watched the 9 p.m. teleserye with her mother.

entries.what: Tuesday: Grace covers the lunch lab-makeup session in B12 after morning classes.
Teaches periods 5 and 6, then grades a stack of lab reports at home.
entries.outcome: Short, clipped exchange with Isabel about dishes.

entries.what: Teaches her five sections and picks up Lola Cora's prescriptions at the Vinca Avenue drugstore after school.
entries.outcome: Prescriptions collected, pill organizer refilled that night.

entries.what: Starts printing inventory sheets in B12 for tomorrow's audit and checks every bottle label.
Before the district audit she prepares a color-coded chemical inventory of B12, then grumbles to Dana that nobody will read it.
entries.outcome: Inventory binder ready on the counter.

entries.what: The district chemical-storage audit of B12 takes place; Grace passes with one note to relabel the acids cabinet by Dec 1.
entries.outcome: Passed the audit; relabeling task added to her list.

entries.what: Eats lunch with Dana, who is relieved for her, then walks the boardwalk at dawn was already done; evening spent at home with Corazón.
Halloween: Grace teaches in B12, and students come in costume; she files the Friday form at 3:30.
Hands out candy at the house on Tamarisol Court to a few neighborhood kids while Isabel goes out with Nadia.
entries.outcome: Isabel checked in by text at 9.

entries.what: Saturday groceries at Ruiz Family Market and rolls and conchas at Panadería Las Hermanas.
entries.outcome: Stocked up with diabetic-friendly options for Lola Cora.

entries.what: Waters calamansi and tomato pots in the backyard and sorts seeds from the library seed library.
entries.outcome: Pots moved under cover before the cold nights.

entries.what: Grace takes Corazón to Tagalog Mass at 9 at Our Lady of the Marsh, then makes lunch and sinigang with her mother.
At the kitchen table she plans Thanksgiving for 11, including Ramón's brother's family, with turkey and pancit, and arranges the layout around her mother's needs.
Because third-period quiz scores on moles dipped, she builds a mole-concept review game and stays up past 11 finishing it.
